motion.name: button-press

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button - registration submit, save config, add lap.
components.css: .ds-btn { cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #005eff; border-color: #005eff; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:not(:disabled):hover { filter: brightness(0.88); } .ds-btn-primary:not(:disabled):active { filter: brightness(0.75); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Important Button
components.description: Urgent/primary-of-the-moment action - Finish race, Reset all.
components.css: .ds-btn { cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-important { background: #e11d22; border-color: #e11d22; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-important:not(:disabled):hover { filter: brightness(0.88); } .ds-btn-important:not(:disabled):active { filter: brightness(0.75); transform: scale(0.97); }

components.description: Signature component: the scoreboard's sticky table header, given a distinct navy identity so it reads as anchored chrome rather than a floating white box while rows scroll beneath it.

narrative.overview: The look is a physical race-timing console, not a SaaS dashboard: flat surfaces, hard corners, thin borders instead of shadows, uppercase mono/condensed labels like a scoreboard display. Every visual decision favors instant legibility over decoration - operators are tapping buttons mid-event under time pressure, and spectators are reading numbers from across a room. This system explicitly rejects the generic AI-templated SaaS look: no gradients, no soft drop shadows, no rounded-pill everything, no decorative color for its own sake.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered surfaces - zero border-radius, zero box-shadow anywhere in the codebase
Condensed uppercase display type for headings/labels, monospace for every number that changes
A tight, functional color palette where every hue has exactly one job
Two distinct surfaces for two distinct audiences: a dense operator console and a large-type public scoreboard

rules.name: The Function-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Green and purple exist solely to mark best-lap/top-of-field highlights; danger red is reserved for destructive confirmations, distinct from the brighter alert red used for routine urgent actions.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any value that changes in real time renders in Roboto Mono; static labels never use mono.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow declarations exist anywhere; border-radius: 0 is set globally. Depth is implied by borders and background tint only.

dos: Do keep border-radius: 0 and no box-shadow on every new component
Do render any live/changing number in Roboto Mono
Do reserve green/purple exclusively for best-lap/top-rank highlighting
Do keep body and .page backgrounds on the same page-tint token
donts: Don't introduce gradients, soft drop shadows, or rounded-pill buttons/cards
Don't add decorative color; every hue has exactly one functional job
Don't compute or format leaderboard/timer values in the frontend
